input.query: SELECT carrier, COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(shipped_ts) AS sample_shipped, MIN(delivered_ts) AS sample_delivered FROM shipments GROUP BY carrier

queries: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(s.delivered_ts) AS n_delivered, ROUND(AVG(julianday(s.delivered_ts) - julianday(s.shipped_ts)), 4) AS avg_days FROM shipments s JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = s.order_id WHERE s.carrier = 'blackcat' AND strftime('%Y', datetime(o.order_ts, '+8 hours')) = '2025'
